messages:
Alex (Support): Escalating to CS — Veridian Health trial activation blocked: embed ingestion returning 429s during onboarding. Marking P0.
Alex (Support): Ticket https://redwood.zendesk.com/tickets/7654321 org=veridian-health-prod. Log: ```2026-03-22T15:02:03Z ERROR rate_limit exceeded org=veridian-health-prod route=/v1/embeds```
Maria (CS): Ack. Jamal, renewal window in ~2 weeks, correct?
Jamal (CSM): Yes. Renewal signal strong; activation must succeed quickly or risk churn. Recommend temporary mitigation and customer comms.
Tanvi (Success): I can run the enablement call tomorrow. Maria, can you send a brief status update to buy time?
Maria (CS): Drafting: "Hi Veridian — were on it. Applied a temporary mitigation while we investigate. Can you share the sample payload and available times for a short troubleshooting call? — Maria"
Nick (Customer Engineer): If we get the payload I can repro. Proposing temporary routing to Dedicated nodes for this org until root cause found (cost minor). Need eng-runtime signoff.
Alex (Support): Payload attached in ticket (payload.json).
Oncall Bot: Incident created INC-2026-0347 severity=P0 assigned=eng-runtime.
Jamal (CSM): Plan: 1) Maria send comms within 30m, 2) Nick request routing/quota change, 3) Tanvi schedule enablement call, 4) CS mark renewal risk elevated.
Maria (CS): Sent initial comms at ts=5130050020.
Nick (Customer Engineer): Requested Dedicated route & short quota bump in #eng-runtime. Pinging oncall.
Oncall Bot: eng-runtime acknowledged. Temporary routing and quota change queued: ROUTE-842 until 2026-03-29.
Alex (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, sending sample payload and available slots."
Tanvi (Success): Meeting scheduled 2026-03-23 14:00 PT. Agenda: reproduce, config check, mitigation steps.
Jamal (CSM): Opened renewal watch; note: activation blocked by embed 429s, mitigated by temporary routing. Risk -> high until post-call confirmation.
Maria (CS): Post-call summary template ready: root cause hypothesis, mitigation applied, customer actions, sentiment, next steps. Will post after call.
Alex (Support): Customer confirmed they can proceed after the session. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-0347 status=mitigated assigned=eng-runtime
Maria (CS): Final note: CS owns follow-ups and renewal outreach; Support will monitor ticket for regressions.
